gloss: to lower, to reduce, to cut

definitions.explanation: To decrease a price, rate, level, or standard.
To withdraw troops, people, or proposals.

examples.japanese: {価格|かかく}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる。
{政府|せいふ}は{消費税|しょうひぜい}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げた。
examples.english: The government lowered the consumption tax.

examples.japanese: {金利|きんり}を{大幅|おおはば}に{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げることで、{景気|けいき}を{刺激|しげき}しようとしている。
examples.english: They are trying to stimulate the economy by significantly lowering interest rates.

examples.japanese: {提案|ていあん}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げるしかない。
examples.english: We have no choice but to withdraw the proposal.

examples.japanese: {部隊|ぶたい}を{前線|ぜんせん}から{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げた。
examples.english: The troops were pulled back from the front line.

examples.japanese: {反対|はんたい}が{強|つよ}かったため、{法案|ほうあん}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げることになった。
examples.english: Due to strong opposition, the bill had to be withdrawn.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

INTRANSITIVE PAIR: {引|ひ}き{下|さ}がる (to step back, to withdraw)

ASPECT: {引|ひ}き{下|さ}げている can indicate an ongoing price reduction or a state of having reduced something.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{価格|かかく}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる (to lower the price)
・{金利|きんり}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる (to lower interest rates)
・{税率|ぜいりつ}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる (to lower the tax rate)
・{水準|すいじゅん}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる (to lower the standard)
・{提案|ていあん}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる (to withdraw a proposal)

ANTONYM: {引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる (to raise, to pull up)

NOTE: Often used in business, economic, and political contexts.
